summary: A stack of 100vh colour screens for the ultra-fat free display face Oi!, separated by bowed SVG curves and shouting in layered two-font type (Oi You for the fill, Oi Mate for the extruded shadow). Three editable samples with OpenType toggles, glyph and language carousels, pointing-hand bands and a donation pitch all keep up the loudmouth voice.

instances.look: 'oi!' at 300px in yellow with a dark maroon extruded shadow on hot pink-red, centred, with a small credit stack below and an Awwwards 'Honors' ribbon on the right edge
instances.ux: static; fixed maroon bar above; ribbon links out
instances.learn: Stack two fonts, a fill and a shadow, in two colours: one word gets the depth of a logo, and it's still live text

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 100vh (from y=50 under the bar). Word centred at ~y=300; credits centred at y≈520–650: award line, 'by Kostas Bartsokas', hairline rule ~400px wide, tagline
reconstruction.typography: 'oi!' 300px OiYou yellow over OiMate maroon/black shadow layer (same text, aria-hidden clone); credits ~14px Averta black, by-line yellow, tagline ~13px Averta Bold caps
reconstruction.behaviour: White screen ~2s before the page shows; static after that
reconstruction.content: 'TDC Award of Excellence in Type Design, 2018', 'A CLARENDONESQUE ON STEROIDS'
reconstruction.html: span._layer1 (OiYou) + span[aria-hidden]._layer2 (OiMate) stacked absolutely, with font-feature-settings inline

instances.look: Full-screen stacks of shouted words: white 'you!' over black 'mate?' on maroon, and on near-black 'FOR / LOUD / DESIGNS / &DESIGNERS' in pink on a teal extrusion, each line narrower to fit
instances.learn: Continue the hero's joke across screens ('oi! / you! / mate!'), so the name is read as a phrase over three scrolls

instances.look: Full-screen colour panels with one giant editable sample ('TRY ME' mint on maroon; '¿¡12.609 tweets only!?' violet on coral; Greek 'Άυλες αυλές…' olive on off-white) above a row of black-and-white chip checkboxes labelled MATE, CAPS, DLIG, SS01, SS02 or ZERO and a small slider chip
instances.ux: Click to edit the text. Each chip flips an OpenType feature; MATE shows or hides the shadow layer; the first panel's slider sets size or leading (range 0–100, value 50)
instances.learn: Tailor the toggle set and the sample to each panel: ZERO only appears with numerals, Greek with CAPS and SS02, so every panel tests what it shows

reconstruction.layout: Each panel 100vh, curved edges; sample centred at ~35% height, wrapped to ~1000px; toggles in a 3×2 grid or a row at ~y=660, spaced ~360px
reconstruction.typography: Sample 180px (first), ~163px, ~103px OiYou, plus OiMate shadow layer when MATE is on; chip labels 12px Averta Bold caps white on black
reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=checkbox][value=mate|caps|dlig|ss01|ss02|zero] rewrites font-feature-settings inline on the sample ("kern", "calt", "dlig" 0, "case" 0, "zero" 0, "ss01" 0, "ss02" 0); input#fader range 0–100; two stacked contenteditable layers, kept in sync
reconstruction.content: 'TRY ME', tweet-count joke, Greek pun; themed humour per panel
reconstruction.html: label > input[type=checkbox][value=…] with chip; input#fader; div[contenteditable] twice for fill and shadow
